text: Think Fiverr for local home services. Plumbers and electricians create a profile with their rates and the areas they cover, customers post a job, and the two sides chat before agreeing a price. The payment is held until the customer marks the job done. Mobile-first. We are a two-person team and want something live quickly.
notes: Escrow is described but no provider is named (P-05 PARTIAL_DEEP). Quickly is a hint, not a timeline. A two-person team says nothing about budget, so P-07 stays MISSING.
